repairs.action: Rewrote the Results net-income bullet. It now names both one-off items by verbatim quote: the discrete tax benefit [[Q-7]] and the noncash warrant remeasurement charge in other income [[Q-11]]. The 'reported EPS overstates the run rate' claim is removed. It is replaced by a labelled judgment: the two items push reported EPS in opposite directions; the 10-Q does not give the after-tax effect of the warrant charge, so the net effect on run rate cannot be determined from the filing; recurring earnings are assessed excluding both items.

The Disclosures data-source line now names the 10-Q (accession {{trigger_accession}}) and, separately, the company's Form 8-K earnings release exhibit EX-99.1 (a separate EDGAR accession) as the source of the guidance and demand quotes. It also names the price provider: unadjusted daily close from the Yahoo chart endpoint (split-adjusted by provider), with peer market values from the same feed. The literal release accession 0000002488-26-000188 could not be included: gates.gate_note flags any digit outside {{key}}/[[Q-id]]/year/period tokens (gate-note-untagged blocker), and values.json has no key for the release accession. Adding the accession would need a values key such as release_accession, which belongs to the compute side, not gen-writer.

The Results heading no longer tags the section '(SEC XBRL data)'. It now says the financial figures are derived by code from SEC XBRL data and that the quoted text comes from the 10-Q. The final disclosure keeps the statement that figures are generated by code and unaudited by the author, with this qualification: reported financials come from XBRL; guidance ({{guide_revenue_next_q}}, {{guide_non_gaap_gross_margin_next_q}}) is taken from the quoted release text, not XBRL; price and peer market values come from the price feed.
